text:
maya: quick check — I'm about to land a small set of lightweight guardrails for chat/completions streaming. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234. TL;DR: 1) disallow client-provided tool_call payloads when streaming is enabled (server should mediate tool invocation), 2) treat message.role as nullable but normalize to 'user' on ingest, 3) add an explicit stream event ordering expectation: `stream_event.type` 'delta'... then optional 'tool' events... then 'final'. can folks sanity-check compatibility concerns? cc @alex @chris

alex: quick read — overall sounds reasonable. main worry is breaking existing customers who do client-side tool_call + streaming. can we gate behind a feature flag (opt-in) for 2 weeks then flip? also recommend emitting a deprecation warning header when we accept the old pattern. :thumbsup:

chris: +1 on feature flag. also flag: we need to be explicit about `tool_call` shape. current clients inline `tool_call` as part of a message: {name, args}. proposal to require `tool_call_meta` be moved into a top-level `tools` array in streaming to avoid interleaving with deltas. example:
```
// proposed streaming envelope
{
  "stream_event": {"type": "delta", "content": "..."},
  "tools": [ {"id": "search", "args": {"q": "x"}} ]
}
```
That keeps reassembly deterministic.

maya: good call. what about backcompat? plan: 1) add feature flag `streaming_tool_call_v2` that when off keeps current behavior but logs a telemetry event and returns a small deprecation header; 2) when on, server validates at connect and returns 400 if client included client-tool payloads. rollout plan: opt-in for 2 weeks, then 2-week warning, then flip for new customers only, then broader. does that sound ok?

sophia: i can own the rollout + integration tests. i'll add unit tests for: schema normalization (nullable role -> 'user'), connect-time validation, and an end-to-end with streaming reassembly. will also add an eval to catch quality regressions. i'll need someone to review the PR and add the feature-flag plumbing in the console. assigning to @alex for console flag UI.

alex: can do console flag UI. small nit: instead of 400 on connect maybe return a structured error with `code: STREAMING_TOOLCALL_NOT_ALLOWED` so SDKs can map to a nice error. and include `retry_after_ms` if migration guidance exists.

maya: agreed — we'll use structured error. adding that to the PR description. also adding server-side normalization examples. snippet i'll add to the doc:
```
// server normalizer pseudocode
for msg in request.messages:
  if msg.role == null:
    msg.role = 'user'
  if streaming && msg.tool_call && feature_flag_on:
    reject_conn({code: 'STREAMING_TOOLCALL_NOT_ALLOWED'})
```

eng-bot: CI status: PR 1234 — unit tests: passing, integration: running, lint: passed.

chris: one more ask — telemetry: add an event for rejected streaming toolcalls and metric for reassembly failures. we need to monitor for client SDKs that break. i'll draft the prometheus counters.

maya: thanks. next steps: sophia to add tests + integration, alex to add flag UI + structured error mapping in SDKs, chris to add telemetry counters. i'll update PR with gating timeline and the deprecation header text. pinging reviewers: @chris @alex for review when tests land. :pray:

alex: i'll review once integration passes. :eyes:

sophia: starting tests now, will circle back with PR update before EOD.

maya: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll hold merge until reviewers sign off and the flag exists in console.
